BackstoryDef.title: storm house ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised as a ward of a storm house that claimed descent from Ao Lingshuang, the dragon princess exiled to the Rim. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the clan genealogies, the wave-like greeting and that a dragon bows to no one.\n\nAt thirteen [PAWN_pronoun] stood under a storm for the Rite of the First Lightning, and the lightning let [PAWN_objective] live.

BackstoryDef.title: storm archivist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept what remains of the archives of the vanished Ancient Dragon Clan: tide charts of the shattered Celestial Sea, the treaties of the Pact of the Four Points and the name of every lord since Ao Zhenhai.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] read everything and swept nothing. Sweeping floors, the old storm houses say, is beneath the descendants of the Sea-Sealer.

BackstoryDef.title: ash orphan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was found as a baby, warm and unharmed, in the ashes of a burned village. The wandering healers of the Nirvana Company took [PAWN_objective] in, wrapped [PAWN_objective] in far too many furs and taught [PAWN_objective] to keep the cookfire alive.\n\nEvery spring [PAWN_pronoun] scattered the company's ashes on the south wind, 'so the fire remembers'.

BackstoryDef.title: cauldron flamekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the alchemy fires of the Heavenly Cauldron Pavilion as one of its Guardians of the Flame. [PAWN_possessive] fire tempered blades, simmered broths and never went out, not even for a single night.\n\nThe gardens of the Pavilion were another matter: every plant [PAWN_pronoun] touched seemed to wilt.

BackstoryDef.title: lotus novice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up as a novice of a mountain temple, sweeping the paths so that no one would tread on the living grass. The Voices of the Lotus taught [PAWN_objective] to set bones, brew bitter herbs and sit beside the dying without looking away.

BackstoryDef.title: valley healer
BackstoryDef.description: Like the qilin midwife Jin Zhi before [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_nameDef] walked from village to village delivering children, mending wounds and witnessing oaths; a promise made before [PAWN_objective] was considered certified.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] never stayed where an execution was planned.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain's shadow child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a village in the shadow of a Fallen Pillar, the colossal shell that became a mountain. Like every child there, [PAWN_pronoun] wore a fist-sized stone around [PAWN_possessive] neck, swapped every year for a heavier one.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] learned to dig, to carry and to wait.

BackstoryDef.title: shell keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a gate warden of an outpost of the Northern Abyss Citadel, in the tradition of Shen Yuan, who held a gate alone for three months. [PAWN_pronoun] raised walls, dug cellars and never once left [PAWN_possessive] post.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] was taught not to fight, but to endure until the world changed.

BackstoryDef.title: fox-wedding child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a day of rain under sunshine, the 'fox's wedding', and grew up among the traveling bards and merchants who came through that small rift. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to sing, to haggle and to tell a lie so pretty that nobody minded.

BackstoryDef.title: Qingqiu courtier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served the scattered Court of Qingqiu as a translator and go-between, selling secrets to every sect and keeping the letter of every deal. [PAWN_pronoun] valued beauty above power and music above swords.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] would rather talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of anything than lift a pick.
